text:
deploy-bot: Canary halted for release webapp v3.4.2 in prod-us-east-1 — preflight values checksum mismatch (expected abc123, got def456). Canary flagged unhealthy pods, rolling back canary instances. job=deploy-1755001234

maria: I see the diff — someone manually applied a configmap with override for db.poolSize in prod-us-east-1 yesterday. That explains the checksum mismatch.

sam: Ugh. Was that from the infra runbook change? Do we prefer to pin back to v3.4.1 or patch the values and re-run canary?

jason: Quick context: we're inside a change window until 17:30 UTC. If we rollback to 3.4.1 we avoid exposing the partial canary, but we'll need a release note and a follow-up migration for any deliberate config changes. Pining is a heavier ops task.

tash: I think a values hotfix is faster — patch the configmap to match the expected values, re-trigger canary, then promote. Pin/rollback only if hotfix fails.

maria: I can patch the configmap now. Proposed command:
```bash
kubectl -n webapp patch configmap webapp-values -p '{"data":{"values.yaml":"db:
  poolSize: 20
  timeout: 30s
"}}'
```
This will revert the accidental override to the standard poolSize.

sam: If you patch, add a note in the canary run: "hotfix: revert accidental config override for db.poolSize" so tracing is clear. Also run a smoke test after canary passes.

deploy-bot: Manual rollback to webapp v3.4.1 initiated in prod-us-east-1 (if patching fails). To cancel rollback react with :white_check_mark:.

maria: Patch applied. I also pushed a temporary annotation so we can grep the change: `kubectl annotate configmap webapp-values rollback-trace=1755001234`

tash: Nice. Re-running canary now: `/deploy webapp v3.4.2 --canary`

deploy-bot: Canary re-triggered for webapp v3.4.2 (run id: canary-1755001234-2). Health checks passing initial probes.

jason: I'll start drafting the short release note and a postmortem stub: "cause: accidental manual configmap override; action: revert values and re-run canary; followup: restrict write access to prod configmaps + add CI preflight to catch values checksum drift."

sam: After canary fully passes, let's promote to staggered rollout and include the release note in changelog under 3.4.2-hotfix. If it fails again we pin and schedule a maintenance window.

deploy-bot: Canary completed: status=PASS -> promoting to staggered rollout across regions. job=deploy-1755001234-promote

maria: Thanks all. Filing a ticket to lock down who can write configmaps in prod.

tash: Marking this thread for follow-up in postmortems. :eyes:
